title: Complete XUI method coverage and controlled exception
description: Verify and, where needed, fix X-UI/3X-UI panel URL validation, controlled private-network exception, credential-free sync payload, API failure behavior, and bounded retries.
acceptanceCriteria: XUI URLs reject URL credentials and unsafe schemes while the explicitly documented private-network test exception is narrowly scoped
Sync payloads never contain passwords/tokens and credentials are sent only through the intended authenticated field/header path
API failures, malformed responses, rate limits, and unavailable panels produce degraded/error state without false running
Retries are bounded and cancellation works during stop/update
Tests cover literal private targets, SSRF controls outside the exception, and secret redaction

steps.details: Add URL scheme/credential, private-range exception scope, payload redaction, malformed response, retry, and cancellation cases before production changes.
Read `config/xui.ts`, xui test route, engine metadata-only runtime, and current XUI tests; document the exact exception boundary.
Tighten only proven gaps in URL validation, exception scope, payload handling, or retry state while preserving intended XUI functionality.
Run focused security tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint; record live XUI test limitations separately.

technicalNotes: The private-network exception is intentionally limited to the XUI test flow; do not generalize it to tools or arbitrary node APIs.
